# Security Checklist: Speaker-To-Mic Leakage Control

**Purpose**: Validate that privacy, diagnostics, egress, secret, audit, and lifecycle requirements are complete before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-06-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are metadata-only evidence requirements complete for leakage status, threshold version, alignment state, route class, confidence, failure reason, and derived-artifact lineage? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, Data Model §LeakageFinalization]
- [x] CHK002 Are forbidden diagnostic fields complete for raw audio, snippets, transcript text, participant speech, meeting content, credentials, tokens, signed URLs, passwords, API keys, absolute paths, and live secret paths? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, Contracts §local-recording-package-leakage]
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements complete for keeping controlled validation stimuli separate from production diagnostics and real meeting content? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013, Research §Decision: Diagnostics Stay Metadata-Only]
- [x] CHK004 Are audit metadata requirements defined for finalization started/completed, unproven, not-measured, leakage-detected, and derived-track events? [Completeness, Spec Constitutional Requirements, Contracts §leakage-finalization-events]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Is "diagnosticSafe" defined clearly enough to determine which package fields are allowed and which content-bearing fields are forbidden? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014, Plan §Constraints]
- [x] CHK006 Is the boundary between safe audio-derived metrics and unsafe content-bearing audio evidence explicit enough for diagnostics and fixtures? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014, Quickstart §Scenario 7]
- [x] CHK007 Are `unproven` and `not_measured` privacy implications clear, so lack of evidence is not filled with raw-content diagnostics later? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010.1, Research §Decision: Preserve Five Leakage Statuses]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK008 Are leakage diagnostics requirements consistent with the constitution rule that desktop clients do not send audio directly to MediaScribe or store MediaScribe credentials? [Consistency, Constitution §III, Spec §FR-017, Spec §SC-010]
- [x] CHK009 Are Langfuse and analytics exclusions consistent across spec, plan, quickstart, and contracts? [Consistency, Spec §FR-017, Plan §Storage, Quickstart §Go/No-Go Rule]
- [x] CHK010 Are derived cleaned track requirements consistent with deletion truth and lifecycle accounting, including local purge/retention participation in future work? [Consistency, Constitution §IV, Data Model §DerivedCleanedTrack, Plan §Post-Design Constitution Check]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK011 Are privacy success criteria measurable without requiring inspection of raw meeting content? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008, Quickstart §Scenario 7]
- [x] CHK012 Are egress boundaries objectively measurable through explicit manifest flags and contract fields? [Measurability, Spec §SC-010, Contracts §local-recording-package-leakage]
- [x] CHK013 Are clean-room dependency requirements measurable for licensing, offline/local processing, CPU, latency, privacy, fallback, and test coverage before coding? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-019, Spec §FR-020]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK014 Are requirements defined for real meeting artifact analysis without storing participant identity, transcript text, speech samples, or live local paths? [Coverage, Spec §US4, Spec Edge Cases]
